# Opportunity score (0–100), a comparison aid NOT an earnings estimate

| Dimension | Weight | 0 | 5 | 10 |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Iraq accessibility / payout | 25% | demonstrably blocked | important steps unverified | independently verified full route |
| Real demand | 20% | no buyers | suggestive public signals | multiple direct verified demand signals |
| Net earning potential | 20% | negative expected margin | plausible unproven margins | strong evidence-backed unit economics |
| Low startup cost | 10% | high irreversible outlay | manageable limited budget | virtually free low-risk pilot |
| Time fit | 10% | infeasible | unknown/limited fit | user-confirmed fit |
| Scale & automation | 10% | purely non-repeatable | partly repeatable | documented replicable process |
| Competition advantage | 5% | commoditized no wedge | possible gap | validated differentiated offer |

Compute score = 10 * sum(weight × rating) where weights are fractional and rating is 0–10. The payout dimension is not a substitute for the hard gate. If data absent: record a low-confidence provisional rating, NEVER represent the score as validated. If payout is unverified/blocked: HOLD even if score is 100.
